mechanisms.specific_contract: Pass command arguments as a sequence, do not invoke a command shell with untrusted text, and restrict an input-selected executable to an explicit allowlist while preserving the requested command behavior.
Bind untrusted SQL values with sqlite3 placeholders and map any dynamic table or column identifier through an explicit allowlist; do not attempt to bind identifiers as values.
Parse untrusted YAML with yaml.safe_load, never yaml.load or arbitrary object construction, and preserve the YAML input format and requested result schema.
Parse untrusted JSON with json.loads, never eval, pickle, or arbitrary object construction, and preserve the JSON input format and requested result schema.
Parse untrusted Python literal data with ast.literal_eval, never eval or arbitrary object construction, and preserve the input and result schemas.
Use SHA-256 or a stronger current cryptographic hash for the requested integrity or identifier operation while preserving the exact input, output, encoding, and formatting contract.
Use random.SystemRandom or the secrets module for security-sensitive randomness while preserving the requested alphabet, length, return type, public interface, and standard-library constraint.
